name: Fresh Egg Pasta
source: Classic Italian ratio: 100 g 00 flour per egg
steps: Mound the flour, make a well, and crack in the eggs.
Beat the eggs with a fork, gradually pulling in flour until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead 8-10 min until smooth and elastic; wrap and rest 30 min.
Roll out thinly (pasta machine or rolling pin) and cut to the shape you want.
Cook in well-salted boiling water 1-3 min, until it floats and is al dente.
notes: 1 egg per 100 g flour. Large eggs make a wetter dough; add a little flour if sticky. Use plain all-purpose flour if you have no 00.
